setup: The inverse undoes \(f(x) = [[fn]]\): write y = f(x), solve for x in terms of y, then rename y as x.

steps.say: On all of ℝ a parabola is not one-to-one, so it has no inverse. On one side of its vertex it is, and the restriction decides which square root to take. The inverse is defined for x ≥ [[k]], the range of f.
